remarks: Step into this exceptional Cape Cod-style residence, a true gem nestled in the peaceful & highly sought-after Cranbury neighborhood, right on the border of Wilton. Perfectly blending timeless charm with modern luxury, this expansive property offers an unparalleled living experience. Main Home Features: 4 spacious beds, 2.5 baths, sun-filled living room with a cozy wood-burning fireplace - ideal for relaxing/entertaining, Elegant dining room with a stylish wood-frame entry to the kitchen, gourmet chef's kitchen featuring premium Wolf range and Sub-Zero refrigerator, custom cabinetry, & luxurious finishes throughout. In-Law Apartment/Professional Suite boasts 2 additional bedrooms, kitchen with center island, bathroom, own laundry, hardwood floors throughout, Ideal for multi-generational living, a private home office, or healthcare/professional use. Previously rented for $2,350/month. 1.16 acres of flat, usable land - perfect for entertaining or playing sports. Oversized deck for hosting summer gatherings or enjoying peaceful evenings outdoor. Stunning hardwood floors throughout the entire home. This residence offers the rare combination of space, versatility, and upscale finishes in one of the area's most desirable locations. Whether you're looking to create cherished memories with family, entertain guests in style, or enjoy the convenience of a home office suite. Minutes to the route 7 connector, tons of shops on Main Ave, and minutes to the new Merritt 7 Train station.

facts.laundryLoc: 1 in main house and 1 in the in-law apt.
